text: I got laid off on Monday after nine years at the company.
My whole team was cut in the reorg, and I am job hunting now.
Rumours of redundancies are going around the office.
I am exhausted and dread opening my laptop every morning.
Working weekends for a year has finally caught up with me.
I was promoted to senior engineer last week!
